claimChanges.claimText: Chatbot ChatAI is listed for Technische Universität Bergakademie Freiberg in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.
TU Bergakademie Freiberg's URZ states that TU members can use GWDG ChatAI through Academic Cloud/Federated Login with central university credentials.
The URZ ChatAI page states that, compared with commercial providers, no data is stored at GWDG or elsewhere or used for training, and open-source models are hosted directly by GWDG.
A TU Freiberg news item says DeepSeek R1 is available to university members through a GWDG agreement for privacy-compliant testing via AcademicCloud services.

A TU Freiberg PDF guide for the Professur für Rohstoffabbau und Spezialverfahren unter Tage states that AI-tool use in student and scientific documents must be clearly identified; unmarked AI use is evaluated as attempted fraud.

Official-source discovery found AI-related university materials, but this crawl did not verify a central university-wide binding academic AI policy; the strongest academic-use guidance found is explicitly scoped to one professorship.
